blocks.raw: ### **Enable RIA Partners to Update Payment Status and Amount**
blocks.text: Enable RIA Partners to Update Payment Status and Amount

blocks.raw: RIA Partners can now change the payment status from `RIA_APPROVED` or `RIA_PENDING` to `RIA_REJECTED`. RIA partners can update payment amounts if payment is in `RIA_APPROVED` or `RIA_PENDING` status.
blocks.text: RIA Partners can now change the payment status from RIA_APPROVED or RIA_PENDING to RIA_REJECTED. RIA partners can update payment amounts if payment is in RIA_APPROVED or RIA_PENDING status.

blocks.raw: New field `updatedBy` added to `users.updated` event and to [Update User](https://developer.drivewealth.com/reference/update-user) response that captures the userID of the user that made changes. When user information is changed through the Update User API or through DriveHub, the `updatedBy` field is recorded.

blocks.raw: [Documents API](https://developer.drivewealth.com/reference/upload-physical-documents) will reject corrupted documents and respond with error code.

blocks.raw: ### **Reject TEFRA Reversal Fee if Outside Trading Hours**
blocks.text: Reject TEFRA Reversal Fee if Outside Trading Hours

blocks.raw: TEFRA Reversal request will be rejected if request is received outside of trading hours.
blocks.text: TEFRA Reversal request will be rejected if request is received outside of trading hours.

blocks.raw: For pending limit orders, the cash available for withdrawal (CAFW) will be deducted by the order amount. Cash available for trade (CAFT) will continue to be deducted by the order amount.
blocks.text: For pending limit orders, the cash available for withdrawal (CAFW) will be deducted by the order amount. Cash available for trade (CAFT) will continue to be deducted by the order amount.

blocks.raw: New KYC error codes `INVALID_NAME_TOO_LONG` and `UNSUPPORTED_COUNTRY` added to [KYC Error Mapping](https://developer.drivewealth.com/reference/simulate-kyc-failures). Errors found while submitting the user will update the [KYC Status](https://developer.drivewealth.com/reference/kyc-statuses) to `KYC_NOT_READY` and add message in `statusComment` field.
